title: Netflix customer support ...  ...
description: I recently moved and I was informed by YouTube's  ' Piperdork '  that leprechauns are responsible for my lost Netflix DVDs.    I took this video when I called customer service

asr.full_text: Closed Caption by YouTube. Good afternoon, and thank you for calling Netflix. My name is Toby. How may I help you? Yeah good afternoon. How are ya? Good thanks! Good, good good good! Well, I'm calling because I uh, I just moved. And uh, I've already submitted my change of address. But here's the thing, um you know, every time you break or end up be the first person this has happened to. Well sir, indeed you are not the first person. Honestly, you're not the first person today. There's nothing that you can do to help me out here? Well, honestly sir, let's say if they were damaged by a unicorn or a jackalope, Netflix then would gladly waive any fees. And there's no way around this. I have to pay $20 a piece to pay for Freddy Got Fingered, Alien from L.A., and Mannequin 2. Honestly, I have to pay for this? It seems that way, sir. Fine, fine, fine. Thanks anyway. If there is anything else I can assist you with today... For nothing. Oh geez. If I would have burned the DVDs I wouldn't even... I'd have less of a problem. I'm calling them back. Where the hell did my... hell did my phone go? Where the hell is my phone? Where the hell is my phone at? I just had it a second ago. Son of a bitch! Everything's gone.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a personal or comedic customer-service interaction about a moved address and allegedly missing or chargeable DVDs, including an absurd unicorn-or-jackalope example. The described phone-and-laptop setting is consistent with that call context, and no investment, payment, product, or data-collection scheme is described.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content is a personal, comedic customer-service anecdote and the caller's subsequent search for his phone, rather than a financial offer, investment discussion, or demonstrated scam investigation.

evidence.observation: The caller says he moved and submitted a change of address.
evidence.quote: I'm calling because I uh, I just moved. And uh, I've already submitted my change of address.

evidence.observation: The caller discusses being told he must pay per DVD for three named films.
evidence.quote: I have to pay $20 a piece to pay for Freddy Got Fingered, Alien from L.A., and Mannequin 2.

evidence.observation: After the call, the speaker asks where his phone is.
evidence.quote: Where the hell is my phone? Where the hell is my phone at?

evidence.observation: The purported representative gives an absurd hypothetical about damage by a unicorn or jackalope and waiving fees.
evidence.quote: Well, honestly sir, let's say if they were damaged by a unicorn or a jackalope, Netflix then would gladly waive any fees.

evidence.observation: A seated person holds a phone to his ear beside an open laptop.
A phone is visible on the table while the seated person covers his face with one hand.
